t: Founded when Ivan IV was crowned the first Tsar of All Russia in Moscow in January 1547.
It conquered the Volga khanates, crossed Siberia to the Pacific and took Kyiv and left-bank Ukraine in 1667.
Peter the Great’s reforms and victory over Sweden turned it into the Russian Empire in 1721.
dyk: Russian explorers reached the Pacific at the Sea of Okhotsk in 1639, less than sixty years after Yermak’s cossacks first crossed the Urals into Siberia.
